newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Jan unemployment up at record adj 4.317 mln.
newsitem.headline: German Jan unemployment up at record adj 4.317 mln.

text.p: German unemployment rose to a seasonally adjusted 4.37 million in January, the Federal Labour Office said on Thursday.
The unemployment rate, which is based on unadjusted data, rose to 12.2 percent, compared with 10.8 percent in December. The number of unemployed workers rose by 160,000 from December.
The January increase was three times larger than independent analysts had expected.
In western Germany, the number of people out of work on a seasonally adjusted basis rose to 3.029 million in January from 2.948 million the month before.
In eastern Germany, the number rose on a seasonally adjusted basis to 1.393 million from 1.187 million in December.
On an unadjusted basis, the number of Germans out of work rose to 4.658 million in January from 4.148 million.
